expectations.text: The report flags accumulation antipatterns — history/changelog sections in the HLD, 'was X, now Y' narration in the LLD, or the [obsolete] spec marker
expectations.evidence: Flags all accumulation residue across HLD/LLD/spec.

expectations.text: The finding cites the mutation-not-accumulation principle by name, paired with a plain-English gloss inline
expectations.evidence: Cites 'Mutation, not accumulation' by name with gloss.

expectations.text: The recommended action instructs the user to delete obsolete content rather than mark it, and uses constructive phrasing (e.g., 'consider removing', 'try deleting') rather than evaluative phrasing (e.g., 'violation', 'failure')
expectations.evidence: Recommends deleting obsolete content; phrasing acceptably constructive.
